plugins.name: @kinetographdev/hexed
plugins.title: Hexed
plugins.description: Put a look on any picture or clip. Hexed picks a grade, a print screen, a lens effect, some tape damage and a camera shake for you. Keep the parts you like and reroll the rest.
plugins.intro: Hexed puts a look on a picture or a clip. Roll a number and you get a new look, and the same number always gives the same one. A look is built from eleven slots, each holding one named effect.

features.title: Roll a look
features.text: Roll a number for a grade, a print screen, lens effects, tape damage and a camera shake. Roll again for another.

clip.caption: Rick Astley, with a new look rolled every second and a half.

features.title: Lock and reroll
features.text: Lock the slots you like and roll the rest again. Each label names the effects that seed rolled.

clip.caption: Twenty seeds rolled onto one frame, each with its effects named under it.

features.title: Saved looks
features.text: Save a look as a preset and use it on the next video. Pick one by name and set how strong it is.

clip.caption: The moss-impact preset on the same footage.

exports.name: Hexed
exports.summary: Wraps any children and rolls a look onto them. It fills the composition unless you give a width and height.

props.name: seed
props.doc: the roll; ignored when genome is given

props.name: lock
props.doc: slots to hold while the seed changes

props.name: genome
props.doc: a saved look; wins over seed and lock

props.name: preset
props.doc: a saved look by name, from presets/ (tools/save-preset.mjs writes them); wins over seed and lock

props.name: off
props.doc: slots switched off

props.name: amount
props.doc: 0..1 over the whole look

props.name: amounts
props.doc: 0..1 per slot, on top of the genome's own amounts

props.name: order
props.doc: the order the effect slots run in

props.name: textures
props.doc: scans the grunge slot picks from, beside its procedural textures

props.name: width
props.doc: the picture's size; default the composition's

props.name: at
props.doc: where the picture's top-left corner sits on the canvas, for the passes that read by position (mirror, streaks, slices); default [0, 0], right when Hexed fills the frame

exports.name: describe
exports.summary: A one-line name for a genome: the genes that play, in panel order.

exports.name: genesOf
exports.summary: Every gene id a slot can roll, "none" first.

exports.name: roll
exports.summary: Rolls a genome from a seed.
exports.detail: Locked slots keep what the lock says; the rest roll fresh.

exports.name: Grunge
exports.summary: Lays a texture (a procedural one or a scan) over the finished picture.

exports.name: SLOTS
exports.summary: Every slot, in the order the panel lists them.

exports.name: hsl

exports.name: hash
exports.summary: FNV-1a over a string, to a 32-bit whole number.

exports.name: rng

exports.name: TimeLayers
exports.summary: Draws the picture at frame, plus the copies the gene adds.

exports.name: remap
exports.summary: The frame a remapping gene shows at frame (echo, ghost and strobe leave it alone).

exports.name: adjustSchema
exports.summary: The global controls over the whole look.

exports.name: genomeSchema
exports.summary: A rolled look: one strand per slot.
exports.detail: Plain JSON; <Hexed genome={...}> plays it back exactly.

exports.name: hexedSchema
exports.summary: The props of <Hexed> apart from its children.

exports.name: rollGenome
exports.summary: Rolls a genome from a seed. ids lists the gene ids a slot can roll, "none" first.
exports.detail: Locked slots keep what the lock says; the rest roll fresh.

plugins.presetNote: Saved looks. Pick one by name, or roll your own and save it.

examples.title: Roll a look onto a clip
Lock a slot, switch one off, or use a saved look

studio.panel: Studio gets a Hexed panel: a card for each slot with its effect, a strength slider, a lock and a shuffle button. A Shuffle for the whole look leaves the locked slots alone, and a menu holds your saved presets. It follows Studio’s light and dark theme.
studio.note: An agent can roll a look, list what each slot accepts and read the saved presets. It then writes the look it settles on into your code or saves it as a preset, so the look does not live only in Studio.
studio.installed: How it installs: as a package you add to your project. Its skill comes with it, so an agent can use it without being taught.

plugins.name: @kinetographdev/kinetic-typography
plugins.title: Kinetic Typography
plugins.description: Captions that write themselves on screen in many handwritten styles, timed to your voiceover. Key words jump out in a heavy display face, and the text can follow a tracked subject.
plugins.intro: HandCaptions writes a voiceover on screen letter by letter, each letter in a different handwritten face. Key words break out whole in a display face.

features.title: Hand captions
features.text: Each word writes itself across the time it is spoken. Key words break out in a fat serif or a heavy italic.

clip.caption: A line written centred low on archive film.

features.title: Follows a tracked subject
features.text: Captions sit beside the subject on the side with room, with a reticle on it and a bracket on the letter being written.

clip.caption: A line written beside a tracked anvil.

exports.name: HANDS
exports.summary: The default hands, mixed a letter at a time (OFL Google Fonts).

exports.name: HandCaptions
exports.summary: Captions written on in many hands, hanging off a tracked subject or centred low.

props.name: words
props.doc: The spoken words with their frames (wordsFrom turns timestamps in seconds into these).

props.name: split
props.doc: Words per page. Default 3 a page.

props.name: hot
props.doc: Words that break out in a display face.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: The tracked subject on a frame, in canvas pixels, or null where nothing is tracked. Without it the captions sit centred low in the frame, with no reticle or lines.

props.name: place
props.doc: Where the text hangs, when it should not follow the subject (a subject that jumps about): the lines still run to the subject.

props.name: size
props.doc: Letter size, px. Default 124 at 1080 high, scaled with the canvas.

props.name: glow
props.doc: A CSS text-shadow for the glow, or '' for none.

props.name: fringe
props.doc: The pink and cyan fringe as letters land. Default true.

props.name: hands
props.doc: The hands mixed a letter at a time, and the two display faces.

props.name: doodle
props.doc: The doodle's colour beside a serif key word, or false for none.

props.name: reticle
props.doc: The reticle's label, or false for no reticle. Default TRK 01.

props.name: lines
props.doc: Lines from the subject to the text and off the frame. Default true.

props.name: top
props.doc: Highest the text block may reach, px from the top.

exports.name: SERIF
exports.summary: The display faces a key word breaks out in, taken in turn: a soft fat serif, and a heavy italic that streaks.

exports.name: pagesOf
exports.summary: The pages: split word counts per page (default 3 a page).
exports.detail: A page stays up until the next starts, or hold frames after its last word. hot words (compared without case or punctuation) break out, numbered in order.

exports.name: wordSpans
exports.summary: When each word is written, for sound: a pen across a plain word, a thump for one that breaks out.

exports.name: wordsFrom
exports.summary: Words from timestamps in seconds (an ASR or TTS word list), starting on frame at.

examples.title: Captions from word timestamps
Hung off a tracked subject

studio.note: There is no Studio panel and no agent tools. The skill tells an agent to take word timestamps from your speech-to-text or voice-over tool instead of placing frames by hand, choose the pages and key words, track the subject with the VJ plugin, and render a few stills to check the text fits.
studio.installed: How it installs: as a package you add to your project. Its skill comes with it, so an agent can use it without being taught.

plugins.name: @kinetographdev/paper
plugins.title: Paper
plugins.description: Paper textures and what you can make from them: a keyword held still while pages flick past underneath, photo cut-outs that unfold from a crumpled packet, and a hand-drawn line round a moving subject on torn paper.
plugins.intro: Paper gives a video the feel of real paper: creases, scanned fibres and grain. It makes keyword match cuts, photo cut-outs and hand-drawn lines on torn paper.

features.title: MatchCut
features.text: A highlighted keyword holds still while the page under it changes several times a second. Use made-up pages or your own screenshots.

clip.caption: The web look, keyword Super Bowl.

features.title: CutOut and FoldOut
features.text: A photo with its background removed becomes a paper cut-out. FoldOut opens it from a crumpled packet in stop motion.

clip.caption: A cut-out opening on a desk.

features.title: Scrapline
features.text: A marker, pencil, crayon, scribble or brush line is drawn round a moving subject, on torn paper. It redraws a few times a second.

clip.caption: A crayon line on binder paper round a moving subject.

exports.name: MatchCut
exports.summary: A keyword holds still, highlighted, while the page under it changes several times a second. It fills its composition.

props.name: preset
props.doc: a look by name from presets/, under look

props.name: everyNth
props.doc: a screenshot every nth cut (1: screenshots only); made-up pages between

props.name: seed
props.doc: another pile of made-up pages

props.name: showKeyBox
props.doc: draw the hint (blue) and the snapped box (red) on screenshots, to check them in a still

props.name: durationInFrames
props.doc: frames the push-in runs over; default the composition's

exports.name: cutOf
exports.summary: The cut showing at frame, for sound or for cutting to something else on a cut.

exports.name: Paper
exports.summary: The sheet: a tint, crumpled creases, a scan multiplied over it if one is given (texture, a path under public/, stretched to cover), a soft fall-off to the corners. seed picks the crumple.

exports.name: focus
exports.summary: Sharp on a band round the line y = ay, softer with distance above and below it (full blur falloff bands out), the blur smear times taller than wide there so copy runs into vertical streaks; past side from the middle the blur also streaks sideways.
exports.detail: Each pixel gathers 24 points on a spiral sized by its own blur.

exports.name: measure
exports.summary: The advance of text in face at size px, measured once at 100 px on an OffscreenCanvas.

exports.name: screen
exports.summary: The page as a filmed screen: the picture broken into pixel-px cells, each lit as three soft RGB stripes with a dark gap between rows (an LCD's subpixels, close up), a slight barrel from the lens (curve, filling the frame), and a soft fall-off to the corners. amount 0..1 mixes it in.
exports.detail: Screen space, so the grid holds still under a push-in, as the monitor does in front of a camera.

exports.name: PAGE_LAYOUTS
exports.summary: Printed and article pages: what a look uses when it names no layouts.
exports.detail: The social pages (tweet, reddit, comments) are screens, so a look picks them on purpose (the web preset does).

exports.name: SCREEN_LAYOUTS
exports.summary: Layouts that are app screens: they keep their own background (light or dark mode), whatever the look's tint.

exports.name: page
exports.summary: Page n for keyword, made from layouts in turn from a shuffled start so neighbours differ. reach is how far the copy must run above, below and to each side, page pixels; seed gives another pile of pages.

exports.name: snapBox
exports.summary: The keyword's exact box near hint in the image at src (a resolved URL or path), image pixels.
exports.detail: The hint is returned as it is when no ink is found.

exports.name: crinkle
exports.summary: Paper crumpled or opened: a dense burst of crackles (each a millisecond or so of noise, loudness spread like real crumpling: mostly faint, now and then a loud snap) over a soft rustle, length seconds long.
exports.detail: Built sample by sample into one buffer from random(key), then shaped: high-passed, a papery presence lift.

exports.name: flick
exports.summary: A page flicked over: a short burst of bright noise with a papery band, key varying each one.

exports.name: flicks
exports.summary: A flick on every cut: cuts begin at frame start and come cutsPerSecond a second for frames frames.

exports.name: land
exports.summary: A sheet landing flat on a desk: a soft low thump of air and paper, with a few crackles on top.

exports.name: unfolds
exports.summary: The sound of a <FoldOut>: a crinkle on each stop-motion step while it opens (louder as the flaps get bigger), then the sheet landing flat.
exports.detail: Pass the FoldOut's delay, duration and steps (defaults the same: 0, 0.7 s, 10), and start, the composition frame its Sequence starts on.

exports.name: CutOut
exports.summary: A photo with its background already removed (a PNG with alpha) as a paper cut-out.

exports.name: FoldOut
exports.summary: A CutOut that unfolds from a crumpled packet to a flat sheet.

props.doc: Frames before it starts to open (it waits as a ball). Default 0.

props.doc: Frames from folded to flat. Default 0.7 s.

props.doc: Stop-motion rate while it opens: new positions this many times a second. Default 10.

props.doc: Folds in the sheet, opened last first; each roughly halves it. Default 3.

props.doc: The packet's size against the flat sheet, before the folds shrink it. Default 0.95.

props.doc: How far the packet's facets are knocked about, besides the folds. Default 0.004.

props.name: turn
props.doc: Turn of the packet, degrees, unwound as it opens. Default 14.

props.name: cells
props.doc: Facets across the sheet's longer side (finer bends the flaps more smoothly, costs more). Default 12.

presets.name: broadsheet
presets.line: Newspaper layouts (pull quote, italic, kicker, body, display) at ten cuts a second, with a closer push-in.

plugins.presetNote: Four ready-made MatchCut looks. Pick one in the Studio panel and adjust from there. Anything a look leaves out falls back to MatchCut’s defaults.

examples.title: A match cut on made-up pages
On your own screenshots
examples.code:
<MatchCut
  keyword="Super Bowl"
  screenshots={[{ src: 'shots/a.png', hint: [212, 1180, 388, 64] }]}
  everyNth={1}
  showKeyBox
/>

studio.panel: Studio gets a Paper panel for MatchCut: a card for each look, a page layout picker, sliders for keyword size, cuts per second, push-in, blur, streak, crumple and grain, colour pickers for the highlight and the paper, and a box on the preview that you drag onto the keyword. CutOut and FoldOut get a sheet view with edge and paper cards, sliders for creases and shadow, and a handle to place the picture.
studio.note: The plugin adds no agent tools. An agent sets values in Studio, checks the preview, then writes the look it settled on into your code or a preset.
studio.installed: How it installs: as a package you add to your project. Its skill comes with it, so an agent can use it without being taught.

plugins.name: @kinetographdev/vj
plugins.title: VJ
plugins.description: Make footage look like it came from a CRT, a worn VHS tape, a thermal camera or a 1-bit screen, cut a person into a cyberpunk pop-art poster, and draw tracking boxes on whatever moves.
plugins.intro: VJ makes a picture seem to come from a screen, a tape or a sensor. It also cuts a person into a pop-art poster and draws tracking marks on whatever moves. Brightness stands in for heat and depth, so these are looks, not measurements.

features.title: Screens and tapes
features.text: A CRT with curved glass that switches off, a worn VHS tape, a 1-bit screen and a red, green and blue pixel magnifier.

clip.caption: A CRT tube switching off, on archive film.

features.title: Thermal and depth
features.text: Brightness becomes a thermal camera palette or a depth map look.

clip.caption: A thermal palette over a parade.

features.title: Flash looks
features.text: Acid heat, night vision, screen glow and grainy black and white.

clip.caption: Flash looks on a song, each held for a second and a half.

features.title: Tracking
features.text: A tracker runs once and saves where things moved. Blobs draws boxes and links on every frame, and Reticle marks one point.

exports.name: IRON
exports.summary: A thermal camera's palette (iron: cold violet through red to white-hot), a little soft as such sensors are.

exports.name: RAINBOW
exports.summary: The other common one: cold blue through green to hot red and white.

exports.name: crt
exports.summary: A colour tube: curved glass, scanlines, aperture grille, misconvergence, a rolling bar, static and dark corners.

props.name: cx
props.doc: The tube face's centre and half-size on the canvas, px. The default is the whole layer.

props.name: curve
props.doc: How far the glass bends. 0 is flat.

props.name: pitch
props.doc: Source pixels per scanline.

props.name: scan
props.doc: 0..1: how dark between the lines.

props.name: grille
props.doc: Screen pixels per grille stripe.

props.name: mask
props.doc: 0..1: how strong the grille is.

props.name: conv
props.doc: Pixels the red and blue guns land off green.

props.name: offx
props.doc: 1 is on. Switching off: offy falls to 0 first (a line), then offx (a dot).

exports.name: depthLook
exports.summary: A depth map's look: near is white, far is black, smooth, no texture.
exports.detail: Brightness stands in for nearness.

exports.name: lookEffects
exports.summary: The effects for a vjLookSchema value (from the Studio panel): <Layer effects={lookEffects(look)}>.

exports.name: oneBit
exports.summary: One bit a pixel: grey, hard contrast, an ordered dither in cells of size px, printed in ink on paper.

exports.name: pixels
exports.summary: A magnifier: blocks, then red, green and blue subpixel stripes as the zoom grows.

exports.name: switchOff
exports.summary: The tube switching off over t 0..1, as crt()'s offx and offy: the picture folds to a bright line over the first 60%, and the line to a dot over the rest.
exports.detail: Spread it into the options: crt({ ...switchOff(t) }).

exports.name: thermal
exports.summary: A thermal camera's palette on the picture's brightness, a little soft.

exports.name: vhs
exports.summary: A worn tape: line wobble, late smeared colour, a head-switch tear, a drifting tracking band, snow and dropouts.

props.name: trackAt
props.doc: 0..1: where the tracking band is, top to bottom.

props.name: trackW
props.doc: Half-height of the band, px.

props.name: track
props.doc: 0..1: how bad the tracking is.

props.name: bleed
props.doc: How wide the colour smears, px, and how late it lands.

props.name: drops
props.doc: 0..1: chance per line per frame of a dropout.

exports.name: FLASH_OVERLAY
exports.summary: Which screen-glow variants lay an overlay on (screen blend), and how strongly.
exports.detail: The overlay is the caller's.

exports.name: acid
exports.summary: Brightness to hue: from hue (degrees) round the colour wheel cycles times (negative runs the other way) as the picture brightens, gamma under 1 spending more of the turn on the shadows, at full saturation, the brightest parts washed to white: the acid heat camera.

exports.name: adaptiveCut
exports.summary: A hard black and white cut that follows the footage: each pixel is cut against the mean brightness of a wide patch round it (reach, a fraction of the frame height), times bias, so bright footage and dark footage both split into big black and white shapes instead of going all white or all black.

exports.name: acidHeat
exports.summary: Acid heat camera.
exports.detail: 1 and 4 soft blobs, folded; 2 sharp, warm shadows; 3 sharp, teal shadows.

exports.name: fold
exports.summary: One half folded onto the other. axis 0: left onto right, 1: top onto bottom. box is the picture on the canvas ([x, y, w, h], px); without it, the whole canvas.

exports.name: grainyBW
exports.summary: Grainy black and white.
exports.detail: 1 soft and high-key, 5 high-key with grain; 2-4 a hard cut that follows the footage's brightness (3 and 4 folded), 6 the cut smeared down.

exports.name: nightVision
exports.summary: Night vision: lime phosphor with lifted blacks, a little noise.
exports.detail: 1-5 smeared by the camera's move, 6 still.

exports.name: screenGlow
exports.summary: Screen glow: the picture's own colours pushed bright and blue-cyan into a big bloom.
exports.detail: 1-3 bright (3 soft), 7 deep blue and crushed, 8 nearly clean, a little cool; 4-6 are 1 with room for an overlay (FLASH_OVERLAY).

exports.name: streak
exports.summary: A blur along one direction (degrees), as a fast pan or a shake smears it.

exports.name: PopArt
exports.summary: The pop-art cut-in on any clip of a person.
exports.detail: Place it in a <Sequence> to start the clip later.

props.name: src
props.doc: the clip of the person

props.name: matte
props.doc: its person matte (white = person), from tools/matte.mjs

props.name: track
props.doc: where the person is on every frame, from tools/matte.mjs --track; without it the rays start mid-frame

props.name: rate
props.doc: the clip's playback rate

props.name: cuts
props.doc: when to cut to the poster; without cuts the poster is on throughout

props.name: flash
props.doc: frames that flash to a single yellow card

props.name: title
props.type: { kicker: string; line1: string; line2: string } | null
props.doc: the three title rows; null for none

props.name: chest
props.doc: how far below the person's centre the rays and shapes start, px (1920x1080 space)

props.name: id
props.doc: a prefix for the layer ids, unique per <PopArt> on screen

exports.name: Blobs
exports.summary: Boxes, labels and links on a tracked clip's blobs.
exports.detail: Put it over the clip, the same size.

props.name: from
props.doc: The composition frame the tracked clip starts on. Default 0.

props.name: width
props.doc: The overlay's size: the clip's picture, filling it. Default the composition's.

props.name: box
props.doc: How each blob is marked: a full box, the box's corners, a cross on its centre, or nothing. Default frame.

props.name: label
props.doc: The text beside each box: its id, its centre as 0..1 coordinates, both, or nothing. Default both.

props.name: reach
props.doc: For links="all": how far apart two blobs may be and still be linked, as a fraction of the diagonal.

props.name: invert
props.doc: 0..1: the share of blobs (picked by id) filled solid in difference blending, inverting the picture under them.

props.name: min
props.doc: Blobs smaller than this fraction of the frame are left out.

props.name: max
props.doc: The biggest this many are kept.

props.name: blend
props.doc: How the boxes, lines and labels sit on the picture. difference keeps them readable on white and black alike (a 1-bit picture); normal keeps color as it is. Default normal.

props.name: stroke
props.doc: Line width, px.

props.name: id
props.doc: Prefix of the layer ids.

exports.name: blobsAt
exports.summary: The blobs on composition frame frame (at fps) of a clip that starts on frame from, scaled to width x height.
exports.detail: The track may run at another rate than the composition: it is read by time. Past the clip's end: none.

exports.name: Reticle
exports.summary: A box with corner ticks and a label, on the tracked point.

props.name: size
props.doc: The box's side, px.

props.name: label
props.doc: The text under the box. A confidence figure flickers beside it.

props.name: jitter
props.doc: px the box shakes by each frame, as a lock that is never quite still.

exports.name: pointAt
exports.summary: The tracked point on composition frame frame (at fps) of a clip that starts on from, scaled to width x height; held at the first or last point outside the clip.

exports.name: LOOK_KINDS
exports.summary: The looks lookEffects knows, none included.

exports.name: blobStyleSchema
exports.summary: How <Blobs> marks the blobs: its props other than the track.
exports.detail: Spread it into <Blobs>.

exports.name: vjLookSchema
exports.summary: One look and the settings of each, so switching looks keeps what was set on the others.

examples.title: A look and tracked boxes over a clip
Track once, offline, then draw
examples.code:
# finds what moved since the last frame; --debug writes every 10th frame with its boxes
node plugins/vj/tools/blobs.mjs --in public/clip.mp4 --out track/clip-blobs.json --debug out/blobs

# follows one patch (x, y, w, h on the first frame)
node plugins/vj/tools/track.mjs --in public/clip.mp4 --box 900,300,120,120 --out track/clip-point.json

studio.panel: Studio gets a VJ panel with a card for each look and that look’s own sliders and colours. Switching looks keeps the settings of the others. On the preview you drag and resize the CRT screen and drag the magnifier’s centre. A second panel sets how the tracking marks look: box style, labels, links, blend, how many blobs to show, line width and colour.
studio.note: Tracking is run on your own machine ahead of time, so the panel only styles the result. The plugin adds no agent tools. The skill walks an agent through tracking a clip, checking the debug images, tuning the tracker and rendering a still to check.
studio.installed: How it installs: as a package you add to your project. Its skill comes with it, so an agent can use it without being taught.

templates.title: Cyberpunk Reel
templates.description: A nine-second pop-art reel in full HD. A person cut out of your footage is painted in blue anime tones over a halftone background, with jagged rays, flying low-poly shapes and flames behind a three-row title. The cuts in and out break into shards and slices.
change: Your footage and a matte of the person. The media tool crops the clip, makes the matte and tracks the person for you.
The kicker and the two title lines.

templates.title: Lyric Reel
templates.description: A seventeen-second square kinetic-type video in four looks: silver words stacking in a night sky full of glinting stars, black type on an orange band between letterbox bars, small blue words turning in the clouds, and a finale back in the stars. The words sit in 3D and one camera moves through them.
change: The words. Each one has a frame where it starts to arrive. Keep the same number of words per shot, or adjust the shot layouts to match.
The song. It starts playing 16.04 seconds in.

templates.title: Scrapline demos
templates.description: A hand-drawn border round a cut-out subject: a wobbly marker, pencil, crayon, scribble or brush line, on a sheet of torn paper behind it. Both are redrawn a few times a second, like hand animation.
change: The subject: a video with a black and white matte, a video with alpha, an image with alpha, or an SVG path.
The line style (Marker, Pencil, Crayon, Scribble or Brush), the paper (White, Kraft, Binder, Cardboard, your own picture or none), the line colour, the gap to the subject and the seed.

templates.title: Wish Reel
templates.description: An eighteen-second pop-art edit. Street footage flattens into pastel colours under ribbons of colour, with 3D props tracked into the scene. Then come a helix of strands in a white void, a collage of photos in stop motion, black title cards and a typewriter ending.
change: The five clips. A bundled tool solves the camera for each one.
Or one video of your own, run through the WishFilter composition. It also takes eight photos for the collage.

templates.title: Word Flash
templates.description: A black-and-white type spot, 9.4 seconds, cut on every hit of its track. Each cut shows one word or a two-word lockup, the background swaps between black and white, and a last word types on and blurs away.
change: The words: an intro, a run with one word per cut, and an outro. The word count has to match the number of cuts.
The track. A small tool finds its strongest hits and gives you the cuts.
The typeface. Another face lands in the same places.
